# Regression Contract Resolution

The old intuitive regression used geometric non-overlap as a proxy for semantic order. Better V2 intentionally creates a subpixel overlap to fuse Prompt and Mode into one deck.

The rewritten test now proves both independent truths:
- Prompt precedes Mode in DOM order via `compareDocumentPosition`.
- The visual seam magnitude is bounded to at most 2px.

All other intuitive smoke coverage remains: viewport placement, collapsed optional intelligence, starter count, no overflow, 13px glass, active-nav dominance, template focus/node identity, reduced motion, and zero browser/network errors.

NEXT_ACTION: run the rewritten intuitive smoke alone, then rerun the complete Better V2 regression graph.
